messages.author: 0cfd5233d7a15aef
messages.subject: Error with latent regression dentype
parts:
Hi Phil, 

I get an error when I use EH(W) with latent regression runs. Any ideas why this is the case? 
Thank you for your help!
 
#simulate data
set.seed(1234)
N <- 1000
X1 <- rnorm(N); X2 <- rnorm(N)
covdata <- data.frame(X1, X2)
Theta <- matrix(0.5 * X1 + -1 * X2 + rnorm(N, sd = 0.5))
#items and response data
a <- matrix(1, 20); d <- matrix(rnorm(20))
dat <- simdata(a, d, 1000, itemtype = '2PL', Theta=Theta)
#conditional model using X1 and X2 as predictors of Theta
mod1 <- mirt(dat, 1, '2PL', dentype = "EH", covdata=covdata, formula = ~ X1 + X2)

"Error in Estep.mirt(pars = pars[[g]], tabdata = tabdata, freq = Data$Freq[[g]],  :
  Not a matrix."

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Error with latent regression dentype
parts:
Thanks. This was definitely a loose check, as only the Gaussian dentype is currently supported for latent regression models. I've patched this on the dev to now throw an earlier error. 

Phil
